_doc: ART LANE: pre-rendered / dithered 16-bit (the Donkey Kong Country look). Glossy 3D-baked-to-sprite forms with heavy dithering. This file IS the style guide — edit tokens/palette knobs to tune the lane; --graphics <this file> switches the whole game onto it.
aesthetic_tokens: dramatic rim lighting and specular highlights
dark moody backgrounds with vivid foreground subjects
